1.title: Series of Michigan Shootings Leave 6 Dead, Including Gunman
1.summary: The gunman, Chad Hickman, was found dead in a wooded area near Whitlock Lake in Caldwell Township, the authorities said. A motive for the shootings was not immediately known.

2.title: Five injured, one critically, in shooting at Virginia State University
2.summary: Multiple suspects were involved in the incident in the early hours of Saturday, the university said.

3.title: Sherrod Brown Seeks Senate Comeback in Ohio, Hoping His Populist Pitch Still Resonates
3.summary: At 73, Sherrod Brown is mounting a comeback bid in Ohio. He is one of the Democrats his party is counting on to retake control of the Senate.

4.title: Israeli Strikes in Lebanon Kill 11, Health Officials Say
4.summary: The Lebanese health ministry said children were among those killed. The Israeli prime minister’s office said Hezbollah had struck first, injuring three Israeli soldiers.

5.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
5.summary: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

6.title: Syrian Convicted in Austria of Civil War Abuses Is Detained in Syria
6.summary: Musab Abu Rukbah, a former police chief, left Austria after appealing his eight-year sentence for crimes committed during Syria’s civil war.
